Raisin Swirl - Our traditional French Raisin Swirl mixes a timeless flavor with a hint of sweetness. Flaky, buttery layers surround a luscious raisin center, making any bite memorable. A great treat for any moment of day.
Chocolate & Passion Fruit - Chocolate cookie filled with passion fruit coulis and topped with passion fruit jam.

Chausson aux pommes - Our classic French Chausson aux pommes is an expression of coated elegance. With a crispy buttery crust and a creamy, spiced apple inside, every bite is pure delight. Ideal for any time of day.
Pavlova - A pavlova cake features a crisp meringue base topped with a luscious combination of mascarpone and whipped cream, finished with fresh fruit
Millefeuille cake - Millefeuille is a classic French pastry consisting of layers of puff pastry alternating with layers of pastry cream, topped with powdered sugar for a sweet and flaky treat.

Medovik - Russian honeycake - Medovik, also known as "Russian Honey Cake," is a classic and beloved Russian dessert. This cake is characterized by its unique layers of thin, honey-infused sponge cake separated by a luscious sweetened sour cream.
Macarons Cake - Macarons Cake – made with light macaron shells, creamy vanilla filling, fluffy raspberry mousse, and sweet raspberry jam.
Macarons Cake - Additional view 1
Chocolate Raspberry cake - Indulge in this delightful dark chocolate cake, filled with raspberry mousse, chocolate mousse and fresh raspberry coulis. A true taste sensation of bittersweet refinement.

Eclair Karamel St. Honore - Indulge yourself in the ultimate treat: our delightful St. Honore éclair! Filled with blissful caramel cream and generously covered with velvety vanilla Chantilly, this heavenly delicacy is a true delight for the senses! Let yourself be enchanted by the delicious flavors and elegant French flair of our St. Honore éclair.
Eclair Chocolat Noir - Savor our éclair filled with airy dark chocolate ganache, topped with glossy chocolate glaze and crunchy chocolate crisps. A delightful indulgence in every bite!
Eclair Earl Grey Srawberry - A delicious éclair with a velvety Earl Grey cream filling, refined with a hint of homemade strawberry jam, and topped with a light Earl Grey chantilly.
Eclair Exotic - A delectable eclair bursting with a luscious mango-passionfruit cream filling, adorned with a light coconut mousse and a tantalizing mango-passionfruit jelly on top.

Eclair Paris Brest - Discover French elegance in every bite with our Eclair Paris-Brest. This pastry masterpiece combines the classic flavors of a Parisian eclair with the iconic round shape of a Paris-Brest. Enjoy the soft, airy choux pastry filled with a creamy hazelnut praline cream. Let yourself be seduced by the perfect balance of sweet and nutty, and experience the indulgence of French pastry with our Eclair Paris-Brest.

Eclair Pecan Caramel - An Eclair filled with a decadent dark chocolate cream, enrobed in a luscious caramel coating adorned with crunchy roasted pecan nuts, and elegantly dusted with shimmering gold for a touch of luxury and indulgence.
Eclair Pistache Framboos - A delightful éclair with a savory pistachio cream filling, subtly enriched with a touch of raspberry jelly and covered with a lush layer of raspberry mousse.
Eclair Vanilla - A delightful twist on the classic: luscious vanilla cream nestled within a crisp choux pastry, enrobed in a decadent chocolate glaze and adorned with intricate chocolate decorations.

Eclair Yuzu Meringue - An elegant eclair boasting a zesty yuzu cremeux filling nestled within tender pastry, elegantly enveloped by a cloud-like Swiss meringue. Yuzu, a citrus fruit with a unique blend of tartness and floral notes, infuses the dessert with refreshing brightness, complementing the sweetness of the meringue perfectly.

Eclair Blauwebes Lavendel - An éclair filled with a delightful combination of airy chantilly and lavender cream, enriched with a smooth blueberry coulis. Topped with a glaze of blueberry ganache and adorned with juicy blueberries, resulting in a delectable treat with a perfect balance of sweetness and refreshment.

Sable Nantaise - Our Sablé Nantaise biscuits are traditional French butter cookies with a tender, crumbly texture and a rich, buttery flavor. A timeless classic, perfect for pairing with tea or coffee.

Madeleines - Our madeleines are classic French butter cakes with a light, fluffy texture and a delicate golden crust. Perfectly baked with a hint of vanilla and lemon, they’re an elegant treat for any occasion.

Bonbons L'Odyssee Exquise - The iconic flavors of the Manufacture brought together in a single box. This selection showcases the CLUIZEL taste: intense chocolate with low sugar content, presented in a beautifully designed box, perfect for gifting and sharing. Featuring a 99% cocoa ganache, chocolates from the Mangaro Plantation in Madagascar, raspberry-filled palets, the Perle d’Or with its nougatine praline of almonds and hazelnuts, chocolate-coated bonbons, and soft salted butter caramel from Guérande... The L’Odyssée Exquise boxes offer authentic and delicious combinations, a gourmet testament to the craftsmanship of CLUIZEL as a Cacaofèvier®, confectioner, and chocolatier.

Very Berry Cake - Whether you're seeking a treat for yourself or a delightful dessert to share during special occasions, our cake of madeleine sponge, strawberry coulis, vanilla cream, and fresh seasonal fruits promises to provide an experience that will enchant all your senses. Enjoy a moment of pure delight with every delectable bite!

Tropical cake - Whether you're searching for a delicious dessert for a special occasion or simply craving a bit of tropical indulgence, our Tropical Cake is the perfect choice. Let yourself be transported to a paradise of flavor with every delightful bite!

Happy Box - Among them, you find classic flavors like chocolate, vanilla, offering comforting familiarity. Then, there are more adventurous options such as raspberry pistachio, passionfruit, and earl grey tea with strawberry, enticing your taste buds with exotic twists. Finally, whimsical creations like caramel, yuzu and hazelnut praline add a playful yet sophisticated touch to the assortment, promising a delightful journey of flavors with every bite.
Sable Diamant - Our Sablé Diamant biscuits are buttery, melt-in-your-mouth cookies with a delicate crunch from their sugar-coated edges. Perfectly crafted for a luxurious and irresistible treat.

Amaretti - Amaretti with candied oranges are delicate almond-based cookies infused with the bright, citrusy flavor of candied oranges. These sweet treats offer a harmonious blend of nuttiness from the almonds and a zesty kick from the candied oranges, creating a delightful balance of flavors in every bite. The crunchy exterior gives way to a soft, chewy center, making them a delightful indulgence for any occasion.
Red Velvet - Red velvet cookie filled with cream cheese and topped with raspberry coulis.

Pain au Chocolat - Our traditional French Pain au Chocolat blends classic flavor with a touch of indulgence. Soft, buttery layers envelop rich, creamy chocolate, making every bite unforgettable. A delightful treat for each of you.

Orange Crown - Our amazing vegan Danish Crown with oranges and hazelnuts will have you addicted from the first taste. The puff pastry contains margarine, therefore it is suitable for vegans. An characteristic creation with a tasty orange core and a lovely hazelnut coating will make a wonderful snack with your coffee.

Croissant - Our authentic French croissant is a celebration of buttery perfection. With its crisp exterior and soft, airy layers, each bite is pure bliss. Perfect on its own or with your favorite coffee.

Cherry Crown - Our indulgent vegan cherry and flaxseed Danish crown will make you love it after the first bite. The puff pastry is made with margarine, so everyone with a vegan diet can enjoy it. An iconic shape with a delicious cherry center with lovely brown flaxseed topping will make your taste buds feel delighted.

Cheese Finger - Our traditional French Cheese Fingers offer a perfect balance of savory, buttery and cheesy goodness. Crispy layers embrace a rich, creamy cheese filling, making each bite irresistible. A delightful snack for any time of the day.
